correctness.rationale: Write f as a constant plus its three adjacent jumps times their step functions. The ℓ¹ norm on jumps gives the exact maximum of column norms, attained by a maximizing step. For u>0 the connected heat kernel is strictly positive and stochastic, so the step residual has strictly negative signs before its edge and strictly positive signs after; two distinct jumps, irrespective of their signs, conflict at a coordinate. Thus even a tie creates no multi-step extremizer. Reflection splits the generator into the even block with eigenvalues 0,2 and odd block [[1,−1],[−1,1+2r]]. The coefficients follow from twice the cross-cut leakage, giving end loss 2(1−H_11) and middle loss 2−(1,1)e^{−uA_r}(1,1)^T. Independently, writing Q=s²+2(1+r)s+2r, the Laplace transform of the difference is (s+1)/(s(s+2))−(s+3)/Q, which gives the positive-convolution identity with transforms ĝ=1/Q and q̂=1/(s(s+2)). At r≥1 both contributions are nonnegative with the convolution strictly positive. For 0<r<1 the ratio (q*g)/g rises strictly since log g has strictly negative second derivative, so each fixed-v integrand q(v)g(u−v)/g(u) increases and the integration interval expands. The ratio starts as u²/6 and tends to infinity since (q*g)(u)→1/(4r) whereas g→0. This proves the unique positive crossing and its sign order. Continuity in r at fixed u>0 forces u*→0 as r↑1, where the local expansion is uniform. For r↓0 use u=x/r and the substitution y=rs in the convolution; g_r(y/r)→e^{−y}/2 and q((x−y)/r)→1/2 for 0<y<x, with a uniform bounded integrand. This gives r(q*g)(x/r)→(1−e^{−x})/4 and the strictly increasing scaled root limit log 3. All conclusions use counting ℓ¹, unweighted jump variation, and positive time. value.rationale: The four-site reflection-symmetric path is the smallest such path with competing balanced and outer cuts. The perturbation exposes a genuine finite-time effect that the unweighted norm cannot see: fast-time sensitivity to conductance initially favors an outer edge when the middle is weaker, but late-time mass balance favors the middle. The record shows a single switch, identifies every equality case even at the tie, and quantifies the separate nearly unweighted and nearly disconnected regimes. This is a complete exact classification within its natural model, not merely a matrix-exponential example.
